ownerRuling.effect: Build a real measured-diff evidence check with an --update mode; a sweep-only scan over the ledger was rejected. First registered case: GOAL_PROGRESS.md row F02-R, whose PASS is pinned to a registry hash that no longer matches any current file.

purpose: GOAL_PROGRESS.md verdict rows pin file identities and are never re-read, so a row can keep asserting PASS against bytes that no longer exist in the tree. Each claim below registers one such pin. demo/scripts/verify-canonical-v1-evidence-measured-diff.mjs re-measures every subject from the working tree and git history: the quote must still sit verbatim in the named ledger row, the pin must be the one the quote carries, the pin must have held at some committed state of the subject, and any difference between the pin and the current measurement must be acknowledged here as SUPERSEDED with the exact commits that moved it. Unacknowledged differences fail the gate.
updateDiscipline: Run `pnpm --dir demo run evidence:measured-diff:update` (or the script with --update) after any commit that moves a registered subject. Update rewrites only the measured blocks from a fresh measurement; pinned and quote mirror the ledger row and are never rewritten mechanically. Registering a new claim is an entry in this file plus the requiredClaimIds list in the verifier.

claims.acknowledgement: Measured 2026-08-17: no committed state of the subject ever hashed to 17561251...a8e3 - all 19 commits touching it (rename-following) were hashed and neither the prefix nor the suffix matches any of them. The F02-R row records its measurement as 'worktree at 7a952e99': the hash was taken from a session worktree after an in-worktree prettier format whose bytes were never committed (the registry was first prettier-formatted in history at c5e88d75, much later, to a different hash), and re-formatting the committed 7a952e99 bytes under the current pinned prettier yields 73d05836...023c, which does not reproduce the pin either. The F02-R PASS verdict is therefore pinned to an identity that cannot be re-derived from history; whether the row's PASS stands, is re-run against the current registry, or is amended is an owner decision - this claim records the measured fact.
